facts.rationale: Corrects the unsupported phase chronology by following the flag from initialization through its lifetime-based producer to the physics consumer, without assuming attribute values or callback scheduling.
facts.value: Unconditionally initializes an ordinary missile and enters motion state 0 with animation updating enabled. It sets facing-relative launch velocity, initializes the ordinary travel lifetime, clears command variables 0, 2 and 3, resets the stored turn, and attaches effect 0x485. Although command variable 0 is initially zero, shared animation processing subsequently recomputes it as lifeTimer > attrs->x4 - attrs->x8. State-0 physics steers and rebuilds velocity while that flag is nonzero; otherwise it applies thresholded velocity damping. The initial flag value alone does not establish a scheduled damping-before-homing phase.
